description: The proposed compute capacity of 20 MW, expandable to 50 MW, is positioned as a foundation for training and deploying advanced AI models locally.
body_lead: The Maharashtra government has signed a letter of intent with Sarvam AI to build sovereign AI infrastructure across the state, with plans to create 20 MW of AI-optimised compute capacity, scalable up to 50 MW, officials said at the India AI Impact Summit 2026 recently held in New Delhi. Chief Minister Devendra Fadnavis and Sarvam AI Co-Founder Pratyush Kumar presided over the exchange of the LoI, according to the Chief Minister’s Office. The collaboration aims to deploy AI systems at scale across healthcare, education, agriculture, welfare delivery and public administration.
